gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id AS s FROM code.calls WHERE call_kind = 'direct' AND callee_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/utils/llm_invoke.py::invoke_with_structured_output') SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.calls c JOIN code.symbols x ON x.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = x.file_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct' AND c.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT s FROM d) AND c.caller_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT s FROM d) AND NOT f.is_test ORDER BY 1

WITH target_sym AS (
    SELECT symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile
    WHERE name = 'invoke_with_structured_output'
    AND module = 'auto_ontology.utils.llm_invoke'
),
intermediates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ce1.caller_symbol_id AS intermediate_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls ce1
    WHERE ce1.call_kind = 'direct'
    AND ce1.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM target_sym)
),
callers_to_intermediates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ce2.caller_symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls ce2
    WHERE ce2.call_kind = 'direct'
    AND ce2.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT intermediate_id FROM intermediates)
),
direct_to_target AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ce3.caller_symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls ce3
    WHERE ce3.call_kind = 'direct'
    AND ce3.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM target_sym)
),
non_test_excluding_direct AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.caller_symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls c
    WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct'
    AND c.caller_symbol_id IN (SELECT caller_symbol_id FROM callers_to_intermediates)
    AND c.caller_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT caller_symbol_id FROM direct_to_target)
)
SELECT DISTINCT sp.symbol_id
FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile sp
WHERE sp.in_test_file = FALSE
AND sp.symbol_id IN (SELECT caller_symbol_id FROM non_test_excluding_direct)

It first resolves the target symbol_id from symbol_profile, then finds intermediates that directly call the target (call_kind='direct'). Next, it identifies non-test callers that directly call those intermediates but excludes any that also directly call the target. Finally, it returns the symbol_ids of qualifying non-test callers from symbol_profile, ensuring only entries with in_test_file=FALSE are included.
